failure.intent: Bittensor 11.1.0 SwapHotkey through Client.execute with retries=0

source_backed_hypothesis: Bittensor 11.1.0 signs a shielded inner at nonce+1 and then explicitly pins the outer nonce into its per-transport cache. After both finalized extrinsics advance the account by two, a later plain execute on that transport increments the regressed cached outer nonce by one and submits the already-consumed inner nonce.
next_supported_repair: After verifying the finalized shielded account nonce equals inner_nonce+1, retire and reopen the public identity-checked SDK Client/RpcSubstrate before a later plain intent. Do not call the private nonce cache, supply an unchecked nonce, retry, or bypass Client.execute.
node_log_redaction: The retained gzip replaces decrypted inner-extrinsic bytes with REDACTED_DECRYPTED_BYTES while preserving carrier hashes and success/failure diagnostics.
